Running Hours Tracker
How it works: Hours are summed automatically from your HSD trip log. Set service interval per vessel to track next engine service due date.
HSD Tank Balance
Balance = Total bunker receipts minus HSD consumption from trip logs. Set fuel tank capacity in vessel specs for accurate % display. Use manual override for physical dip readings.

Drill Records (SOLAS Compliance)
SOLAS Requirement: Fire drill and abandon ship drill monthly. Enclosed space entry drill every 2 months. MOB drill at least every 3 months.
Incident / Near-Miss Log
ISM Code Requirement: All incidents, accidents, near-misses and hazardous situations must be reported, investigated and recorded. Near-miss reporting is encouraged — no blame culture.

💾 Backup, Offline Extraction & Restore Center Lossless Recovery Engine
Export folder-wise, vessel-wise archives, download full JSON system snapshots, or seamlessly input/restore backups with 100% schema integrity
🗂️ Vessel-Wise & Folder-Wise ZIP Export
Extracts a complete structured ZIP archive with dedicated folders:
  • 📁 01_Vessels_Fleet/[Vessel_Name]/ (Certificates, Fuel, Maint, Crew)
  • 📁 02_Material_and_Challans/ (Printed Delivery Challans, POs, Inventory)
  • 📁 03_Crew_and_Indos/ (Manifest, Contracts, Leave)
  • 📁 04_Finance_and_Invoices/ (Invoices, Salaries)
  • 📁 05_Universal_Restore/ (Includes website-ready master JSON)

Firebase Project Config
Get these values from: Firebase Console → Project Settings → Your Apps → Web App → Config
Setup guide:
1. Go to console.firebase.google.com
2. Create a new project → Enable Realtime Database → Set rules to authenticated access
3. Project Settings → Add Web App → Copy config values here
4. Authentication → Enable Email/Password provider
5. Click "Save & Connect" — TugWatch will auto-sync all data to the cloud
